entry.title: New: msds-chain-mcp#dsh
entry.summary: Chemical safety intelligence through the hosted MSDS Chain MCP endpoint: 23 tools for compatibility and mixing order, GHS hazards, PPE, storage, waste disposal, exposure limits, transport classification, multi-region regulatory compliance, SDS lookup and version diffs, and signed audit reports, each answer citing the supplier SDS and revision date it is grounded in. Exact install spec: github:littleblakew/msds-chain-mcp#path:/plugins/dsh. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
